_comment: Demo 01 'Frozen Lake' tutorial steps, REV 5 (user flow 2026-10-13; docs/demo/DEMO01_BEAT_SHEET.md). Read at runtime by UTutorialSubsystem
(the level JSON 'demo': {'tutorial': true, 'tutorial_steps': 'demo_01_steps.json'} selects this file). Schema: HANDOFF section 6 'Tutorial'.
Texts are ids only (TUT_*, WT_*, OBJ_*): English text comes from the narrative manifest 'tutorial' section (TANDEM request #17), else
Content/Data/Tutorial/demo_01_texts_draft.json, else '[EN missing: <id>]'. Command ids: Source/CodexTactics/Public/Core/PlayerCommands.h.
Beats implemented here (Phase 1 = user steps 1-9 + the standalone A3 fence / A4 cone cards): A0 drop (the HQ radio talks while the squad may

already walk and the staged camera lesson runs alongside; 'click to walk' right after the camera chain, rev 5c; sprint locked until A1, rev 5e), A1 crossing (the shaky bridge holds the followers: one at a

time on its own, rev 5c; squad banter, cold -> heat pack = inventory unlock, 'double-click to run' = sprint unlock (rev 5e), hut: a tactical entry = select + solo + cover at the door, loot, share the heat packs (rev 5d), regroup, box), A2 camp (rev 5d: push the barrel into the half-ruined building + light it there),
A3 approach (stances, vault, low fence crawl, cover, mines / wires spotted), A4 ambush (vision-cone toggle, tripwire; the fight itself is Phase 2).
Beats A5-A8 are designed in the beat sheet only.
PROGRESSIVE UNLOCK (user request 2026-10-13, beat sheet section 'Locks'): beat A0 locks every command family not taught yet; camera, Order.Move /
Order.Interact (walk-up), Select.*, Dialogue.* and System.* are never locked; SPRINT is locked again from the level start until the heat pack lesson (rev 5e,
user decision 2026-10-14: A1_sprint 'double-click to run' unlocks it; a locked double click walks, one line A0_nosprint). Each lesson step unlocks what it teaches ('unlock'; a single
command out of a wider lock becomes a '!<id>' exception); every later beat repeats the earlier unlocks as a safety; a wave / horde fight or
the tutorial switched OFF unlocks everything (UTutorialSubsystem). A locked press: one 'Not yet - follow the training.' feed line per family.
'cancel_on' (rev 5e): a radio / walk-and-talk about a place or a moment is dropped when it is over (the bridge lines once the squad is across; never queued to play later).
Leftover hint cards of an earlier beat are dropped when a later beat starts (beacon 1 reached during the camera lesson: precredited or skipped).
'precredit' (default true): a command card the player already did before it was due is completed without showing it.
Volume ids (VOL_*) are the VolumeId / StepId of ATutorialTriggerVolume actors placed in L_Demo01_A_FrozenLake:
VOL_A0_BEACON1 (BeatId A1, at beacon 1), VOL_A1_BEACON2 (the crack / the bridge approach, kept), VOL_A1_HUT_APPROACH (rev 5c, Leader, ~10 m in front of
the hut door), VOL_A1_DOOR_L / VOL_A1_DOOR_R (rev 5c: the wall left / right of the door, cover 'in_volume' filters), VOL_A1_HUT (the hut INTERIOR only, Any
Operative, Fire Once OFF),
VOL_A1_BEACON3 (kept), VOL_A2_CAMP (BeatId A2, kept), VOL_A3_APPROACH (BeatId A3, NEW: the complex comes into view), VOL_A3_WIND (was
VOL_A1_BEACON4: move it to the approach), VOL_A3_RIDGE / VOL_A3_RIDGE_FAR (were VOL_A1_RIDGE / _FAR: move them), VOL_A3_FENCE (NEW: in front of
the ACrawlGapActor low fence), VOL_A3_FIELD (was VOL_A6_FIELD: the cover field on the approach), VOL_A4_OVERLOOK (BeatId A4, NEW: the patrols
come into view). New level actors: ABridgeCrossingVolume over the crack (events BridgeEntered / BridgeRefused / BridgeCrossed), ACrawlGapActor
(events CrawlGapRefused / CrawlGapPassed). Heat pack used: event ItemUsed.HEAT_PACK; loot: Loot.Open / ItemLooted.HeatPack; locked command
tried: event Tutorial.Locked.<CommandId>; cover events CoverEntered (+ .High / .Low), CoverShimmy, CornerReached ('distinct_operatives': true
counts each operative once); the player's vision-cone toggle: command View.VisionCones (O), event VisionConesToggled(.On/.Off).

steps._comment: User flow step 1 (rev 5b, user requests 2026-10-13): the HQ radio opens the level as a talk-on-the-move - the squad may walk and run while HQ talks, the camera lesson runs alongside. Enter = next line, hold Enter / SKIP = the whole radio (finished as played out).
The objective shows with the radio (the squad may walk at once).
Inventory and items are locked until the heat pack lesson (user flow step 1): one feed line on the first try.

Camera lesson, STAGED, WHILE HQ talks (user request 2026-10-13; the card column and the radio strip never overlap): pan -> MMB drag pan -> turn with Q/E -> free look -> zoom, then the walk card. No timeout: each card waits for the real input (skippable). hold_s = accumulated time the continuous input was active while the card was shown. 'precredit' (default): a stage the player already did earlier is ticked off without showing. Beacon 1 reached early (beat A1): the leftover camera cards are dropped.

Movement lesson right after the camera lesson (rev 5c, user request 2026-10-13): 'Click to walk' as soon as the camera chain ends (no longer waits for the HQ radio), done on a move order; precredited when the player already walked. The beacon objective (A0_obj_beacon) still asks for beacon 1. Beacon 1 reached early (beat A1): the leftover A0 cards are dropped (precredited or skipped).

Rev 5e (user decision 2026-10-14, reverses rev 5b 'sprint never locked'): no 'double-click to run' card here any more - sprint is locked until the heat pack lesson (A1_sprint teaches it). A double click while it is locked walks; the first try gets this one line (no card, no generic 'Not yet').

Rev 5e (game designer 2026-10-14: talk about a place must end when the squad has left it): 'beacon two is past the crack' is dropped once the squad reaches the crack (the bridge lines take over) or has crossed.

User flow step 4 (rev 5c 2026-10-13: the bridge teaches NOTHING - no select / solo): the crevasse at beacon 2 with the shaky bridge (ABridgeCrossingVolume, capacity 1) holds the followers at the edge on its own, so the squad crosses one at a time automatically. VOL_A1_BEACON2 is the approach. A short line, then the objective is done when all three are across. Rev 5e (game designer 2026-10-14): the two lines (~9 s) play on the approach / during the crossing (one at a time takes ~10 s); once all three are across (A1_bridge finished) whatever is left of them is dropped, never played later (cancel_on).
Done when every operative has crossed (BridgeCrossed x3, distinct operatives; the bridge refuses a second body itself). Never precredited (event completion). The marker Step Id A1_bridge shows it.
The bridge creaked (the player sent a second operative on while one is crossing): one feed line.
User flow step 5: the squad walk-and-talk (the banter that used to open A0) plays after the bridge.

Tutorial safety (kept from rev 3): 20 s after the crossing, if nobody is at Chills (40 %) yet - the player kept out of the wind zone, or the level's cold_rate_mult kept it low (0.4 since rev 5g: walking only the squad is ~45 % once across, so the gust is usually skipped) - a scripted gust: the line + every operative +20 cold, at least 42 % (a cold shock: never scaled by cold_rate_mult) so the heat-pack lesson always starts.

User flow step 6: heat pack USE lesson with the STARTER packs (level JSON squad_loadout.heat_packs_count 1 = one per operative). The inventory and items UNLOCK here (step 'unlock'). Focus = the coldest; never precredited.
User flow step 7: the squad feels better after the packs (rev 5e: 'running keeps you warm' moved into the sprint card right after it).

Rev 5e (user decision 2026-10-14): THE SPRINT LESSON right after the heat pack lesson - 'By the way - running keeps you warm. Double-click to run.' UNLOCKS Order.Sprint (locked since A0), done on a sprint order; never precredited (running was impossible before). Its followers (resupply line, hut objective) fire when it ends (60 s timeout). Rev 5g (game designer 2026-10-14, 'waiting for instructions' on arrival): still up at the hut approach it is dropped there (cancel_on; its unlock stays) so the hut-entry select card shows at once (a cancelled card arms no breather).
User flow step 8 (resupply, rev 4 order kept): after the sprint card the squad is 'nearly out' -> the hut. The user's TutorialMarkerActor with Step Id A1_obj_hut shows from here.

Rev 5c (designer review 2026-10-13): the TACTICAL HUT ENTRY teaches Solo + selection + cover. Rev 5i (game designer 2026-10-15: 'they just run everyone inside and skip the lesson'): VOL_A1_HUT_APPROACH (Leader, ~10 m in front of the door) starts the walk-and-talk and the SOLO card, which CONFINES the squad to the approach area until the third operative is inside (A1_hut_enter finished): move orders outside it are refused ('Hold here - follow the training.'), formation moves stay inside; VOL_A1_DOOR_L opens when its card is up, then VOL_A1_DOOR_R, then VOL_A1_HUT - so the order is enforced (left, right, then the third goes in; three DIFFERENT operatives, 'distinct_from'). Released on completion, tutorial OFF / SKIP TUTORIAL, a fight. No timeouts on these cards (the card's Skip still skips one lesson). Markers: Step Id A1_hut_stack_l / A1_hut_stack_r / A1_hut_enter. Left / right as seen by the squad approaching the door.

Rev 5i: Solo FIRST (the designer's order: B, then pick the operative, then send him). Unlocks Squad.Solo / Squad.Regroup. Not precredited (Solo must be ON now). Holds the squad in the approach area (confine).
Rev 5i: select the operative to send (1 / 2 / 3 or a click on him / his portrait). Not precredited: selections made earlier in the level do not count.
Cover is taught here now (rev 5c; A3 is the refresher in the cover field). Done when an operative settles in cover inside VOL_A1_DOOR_L (CoverEntered + in_volume).
The third operative walks in (VOL_A1_HUT covers the interior only: the two at the door never stand in it). Rev 5i: the hut opens only when this card is up; the confinement ends when it finishes.

Inside: the crate (the two at the door hold their positions until the regroup). Rev 5e: dropped once the crate is open (A1_loot_open finished); the approach lines are dropped once the third man is inside, the resupply line once the squad is at the hut, the 'split them up' line once the packs are shared.

Rev 5d (game designer 2026-10-14): share the hut's heat packs - every operative carries at least one AND at least one pack was handed over between squad mates (stat heat_packs_given, since the level started), so the hand-over is always practised once. Always solvable: 3 starter packs (1 each) - the 1-2 used in the heat pack lesson + the crate's 3 >= 3, stack max 3 each. Precredited when it already holds (the looter handed them out before the card came). The real input: select the looter, open the inventory (I), hold Shift and drag a heat pack onto a mate (his body or his action-bar portrait); without Shift a cold mate cracks it at once (Sprint 15).
Not precredited: the squad stands in solo mode (two at the door, one inside) and must actually regroup (Solo off). Rev 5d: after the share card.
Box select moved from the bridge (rev 5c: the squad arrives over the bridge together, there is nothing to gather there) to after the hut regroup.
Beacon 3: formation lines (the guard card moved to the horde beat A8: the Engineer guards the repaired generator).

User flow step 9 (A2, VOL_A2_CAMP), rev 5d (game designer 2026-10-14): cold again - push the barrel standing outside INTO the half-ruined building (VOL_A2_RUIN = its interior; the subject of RelocationDone / BarrelLit is the barrel itself, so 'in_volume' asks where the barrel is) and light it there. Indoors: out of the wind (the ruin's Shelter zone halves the cold) and a fire inside does not give the squad away (dialogue; the deployable campfire's patrol alert shrinks indoors, barrels alert nobody - rev 5d note).

Rev 5d: the walk-and-talk about the ruin (Engineer / Commander): warm up by a barrel indoors, and a fire inside does not give you away like an open campfire. Plays after the cold lines (rev 5g: while the push card is already up). Rev 5e: dropped once the barrel burns in the ruin (A2_light finished) - never talked about afterwards.

Rev 5d: push the barrel INTO the ruin - done when a barrel is set down inside VOL_A2_RUIN (RelocationDone, subject = the barrel). Out of combat a push runs at once; in a live fight only from the tactical pause (Object.Relocate rule 2026-10-08) - the card says so. The marker with Step Id A2_push rings the spot inside the ruin. Rev 5g (game designer 2026-10-14: the player waited ~20 s for the cold lines before the task showed): the card shows ON ARRIVAL (beat start = VOL_A2_CAMP, or VOL_A2_RUIN reached first), with the objective; the cold / ruin lines play alongside (radio strip bottom centre, card bottom left).
Remedial only (the heat pack is taught in A1): someone is very cold again after the barrel lesson and the squad still has a pack.

User flow step 10 (A3, VOL_A3_APPROACH): the cautious approach to the complex - mines and wires, cover, stances, vault, crawl under the low fence. Sprint is NOT locked here. 2026-10-19 (game designer): the squad enters the complex DEFENSIVE ('set_posture' action when the lines play): no fire of its own on enemies that have not spotted it - an Aggressive squad would start the A4 fight by itself the moment a patrol came into view, before the posture lesson.

Rev 5i (game designer 2026-10-15): the complex comes into view ('That's the complex. The PMC left in a hurry ...') - the squad is STOPPED and held at the approach (VOL_A3_APPROACH, Beat A3, Leader) and moves up to the first low obstacle ahead, the vault ridge (VaultRidge_A3, 0.8 m; its approach side VOL_A3_RIDGE) only CROUCHED: every move order of a standing operative is refused ('Crouch first - stay low.'), followers copy the leader's low stance before they follow; the corridor approach -> ridge front is allowed (span), nothing beyond. Done when every living operative is crouched / prone inside VOL_A3_RIDGE (stat squad_not_low_in). Unlocks the stances here (they were locked until the wind card). A volume trigger, not the beat start: a squad that reached A3 another way (the fence first) passes it.
Stances at the wind strip (was A1 beacon 4: VOL_A1_BEACON4 -> VOL_A3_WIND). Precredited if the player already used two stance keys.
Vault over a low ridge (was A1: VOL_A1_RIDGE / VOL_A1_RIDGE_FAR -> VOL_A3_RIDGE / VOL_A3_RIDGE_FAR).

Rev 5i (game designer 2026-10-15): the low fence (ACrawlGapActor) is crossed ONE BY ONE. Arriving at VOL_A3_FENCE (Any Operative, 3.5 m before the fence) the squad STOPS and is held there (confine); first Solo (B) - done at once when the squad already is in Solo (condition squad_solo, precredited). Regroup is locked from here until every operative is in his own cover beyond the fence (A3_peek unlocks it; a press says 'Not yet - one by one.').

Rev 5i: then each operative: select him, go prone (V), crawl under the gap - one at a time. Held at the fence area; an order past the fence is allowed only for a PRONE operative and only when nobody else is crossing (his turn ends with his CrawlGapPassed); standing: 'Go prone first - then crawl under.', another crossing: 'One at a time - wait until he is through.'. Alt+V still works but every operative counts separately (3 distinct). The card shows '{progress} / {count} through'.
Rev 5i: Regroup is locked during the crossing and the cover lesson: one line instead of the generic 'Not yet' (any press, every time).

Rev 5i (game designer 2026-10-15): beyond the fence, still in Solo, each operative into his OWN cover - one order each, three different operatives (CoverEntered, distinct; the only operatives who can take cover now are past the fence). Replaces the rev 5c refresher (VOL_A3_FIELD card + squad card + squad-cover objective). The cover field lessons (bound, the peek that reveals the mines) follow only after it. '{progress} / {count} in cover'.

Corner peek card (rev 5c; low cover too since rev 5e). Rev 5h (game designer 2026-10-15): the peek is meaningful - two hidden mines (SpotEventTag A3PeekMines, map section AutoLayout_Demo01_5h) lie beyond the corner of the first high wall (marker A3_peek); leaning out round a corner spots hidden traps in the peek sight cone (AOperativeCharacter::PeekSpotConfig). Done when those mines are known (condition stat traps_spotted.A3PeekMines: also precredited when they were found before the card), or after 90 s. The mine card A3_mine (MineSpotted) follows: disarm or go round. Rev 5i: after the cover-each card; frees Regroup again.
PMC traps on the approach: a hidden mine spotted (any operative) / a wire spotted -> one card each, done by dealing with it (or it times out).

Rev 5e (user bug 2026-10-14: 'the tripwire cannot be disarmed'): the disarm stayed LOCKED until the wire card SHOWED, and the card queued behind the cover / peek / mine cards of the field for minutes (the 'Not yet' line comes once per family: later refusals were silent). Now beat A3 (VOL_A3_APPROACH) unlocks Trap.DisarmMine / Trap.DisarmTripwire / Attack.TargetedShot, and a feed line says how at the moment a wire / mine is spotted (a feed never waits for a slot). The cards stay as the longer explanation. Rev 5h: a spotted trap switches the squad to Solo, so these lines also free Squad.Solo / Squad.Regroup (B) in case a trap is met before the hut lesson.

2026-10-19 (game designer play-test): THE POSTURE LESSON right after the trap disarm lesson (A3_wire finished - disarmed, prone, timed out or skipped): the Commander's radio 'Hold your fire' + the card with the three postures and their keys; it unlocks Posture.* (locked since A0) and completes on Posture.Passive (, or Alt + ,) - the stealth part of the complex. BEAT-LESS on purpose: a later beat never drops it (the overlook is only 13 m past the wire). 'requires' A3_cover: a wire spotted before the cover field (the player wandered off) does not arm it. Its A4 twins (A4_posture_radio / A4_posture) teach it at the overlook when the wire was never spotted; whichever pair finishes first cancels the other (cancel_on both ways).

User flow step 11 (A4, VOL_A4_OVERLOOK): the patrols come into view. Phase 1 ships the vision-cone toggle card and the tripwire card; the ambush fight itself (patrol encounter group) is Phase 2 (beat sheet rev 5 section 1.3).

2026-10-19: the posture lesson at the overlook when the A3 one never ran (the wire was never spotted / was tripped). Cancelled at once when A3_posture_radio / A3_posture already finished; cancels them when it finishes first (cancel_on both ways).

2026-10-19 b (game designer play-test): SYMMETRIC SIGHT - prone behind cover the patrols cannot see the squad, and the squad cannot see them either (an enemy no operative sees from his eye height is hidden: no plate, no cone, not targetable, no fire; a last-known silhouette fades). The card shows the first time someone lies prone while an enemy is out of the squad's sight (condition: squad_prone >= 1 AND enemies_unseen >= 1; 'requires' A4_cones = only from the overlook on, never in A3 where nobody is out there). Done when he rises / crouches / peeks round the cover, or after 20 s.

2026-10-19 b (game designer play-test): THE AMBUSH, part 1 - the wire is rigged, now wait until a patrol walks into it (event TripwireTriggered.Enemy: an ENEMY pulled the pin of any wire - the squad's own or a PMC one; the 140-damage blast kills a frostbitten / a hound). 240 s at most: the lure part follows either way (a wire that never caught anyone still leaves two to lure).

2026-10-19 b: THE AMBUSH, part 2 - the other enemy is LURED: whistle [5] from cover (the noise at the whistler: he comes to you) or throw a stone [6] (the noise where it lands: he goes there). Unlocks Stealth.* (locked since A0). Done when an enemy reacts to a lure - it heard it and investigates (event StealthLure.Heard from UStealthLureSubsystem::EmitNoise; the lure needs exploration and an undetected squad). Never precredited (a lure before the card does not count), 180 s.

2026-10-19 b: the reminder once he is coming - AGGRESSIVE opens fire the moment he is in sight (the fight starts through the normal path), or Ctrl+click him. Done on Posture.Aggressive, a targeted shot or the fight starting (CombatStarted; a fight unlocks everything anyway); 60 s.

Rev 2026-10-19 (game designer play-test): the MEDKIT lesson the first time an operative is badly hurt - a mine / tripwire blast, frostbite, a lesson down (the guard leaves him at 1 HP). No beat: it can come in any beat (never dropped by a later beat), once. Trigger: the most wounded living member lost at least 30 % of his health = below 70 % (stat squad_injury_max, data). Focus = that operative (the {focus} name, a WOUNDED line over him). Unlocks what it teaches (the progressive locks must not block it). The real input: select him and press H (his own medkit), or the inventory [I] Medkit line; a mate's medkit: drag it onto him in the inventory (Item.Give), then H. Completes when a medkit heals THAT operative (ItemUsed.MEDKIT with him as the subject - H / the drawer line, or a mate's field aid). Every operative carries 1 medkit (BP default MedkitsCount, the level loadout does not change it; the hut crate holds none).
